deva: तस्याः कुबेरो वैश्रवणो वत्स आसीदामपात्रं पात्रम् ।
iast: tasyāḥ kubero vaiśravaṇo vatsa āsīd āmapātraṃ pātram
tāṃ rajatanābhiḥ kaberako ’dhok tāṃ tirodhām evādhok

chants.src: Amarakośa, Svargavarga: the names of Kubera

iast: mahāpadmaś ca padmaś ca śaṅkho makarakacchapau
mukundakundanīlāś ca kharvaś ca nidhayo nava
śarīram iva jīvasya dīpasya snehavat priye
sarveṣām api devānāṃ tathā yantraṃ pratiṣṭhitam

deva: राजाधिराजाय प्रसह्यसाहिने । नमो वयं वैश्रवणाय कुर्महे ।
स मे कामान्कामकामाय मह्यम् । कामेश्वरो वैश्रवणो ददातु ।
iast: rājādhirājāya prasahyasāhine / namo vayaṃ vaiśravaṇāya kurmahe
sa me kāmān kāmakāmāya mahyam / kāmeśvaro vaiśravaṇo dadātu
chants.credit: Taittirīya Āraṇyaka, ed. R. Mitra, Calcutta 1872, p. 187

deva: शिवसखं मुकुटादिविभूषितं वरगदे दधतं भज तुन्दिलम् ॥
iast: śivasakhaṃ mukuṭādivibhūṣitaṃ varagade dadhataṃ bhaja tundilam
chants.credit: Kubera, bronze, Nālandā, 10th c. Photo: Photo Division, Govt. of India (public domain)

iast: viparītāṃs tu tān buddhvā tvayi vāsam arocayam
